doc.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Growing up near Cleveland and Maurice Sharp's long tenure
summary: She is from near Cleveland; Sharp was principal flutist for 44 years under Rodzinski and Szell, a strict taskmaster.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Yeah. So you’re from — where are you from? I didn’t have this information.
From just outside Cleveland, Ohio. And so that was how I had that association in Cleveland with Maurice Sharp. He had been the principal flautist of the Cleveland Orchestra for 44 years.

Yeah. He was there in the Rodzinski days and the George Szell days. That was quite a — he was quite an icon. He was a big deal to study with. And very, very strict. He was one of the last of the real task masters.
